# QA Plan: Production SYS-SAVE / SYS-PERSIST / SYS-TEST
**Date**: 2026-08-10
**Generated by**: /qa-plan
**Scope**: 30 incomplete Stories across SYS-SAVE, SYS-PERSIST, and SYS-TEST; already COMPLETE SYS-SAVE Stories 001-006 are excluded.
**Engine**: Ren'Py 8.5.3 / Python 3.12-compatible logic
**Review mode**: Solo/Lean; external QA-lead gate deferred by project policy.

## Test Summary

All Logic and Integration Stories require the exact automated test path stated in
their Test Evidence section. UI Stories require an interaction test or evidence
document. Every acceptance criterion is mapped to at least one test function or
an explicit evidence fixture before story closure.

| System | Stories | Primary automated coverage | Manual/evidence coverage |
|---|---:|---|---|
| SYS-SAVE | 007-012 | `tests/unit/sys_save/` and `tests/integration/sys_save/` | blocking/UI/performance/build evidence where applicable |
| SYS-PERSIST | 001-013 | `tests/unit/sys_persist/` and `tests/integration/sys_persist/` | UI and engine performance evidence where applicable |
| SYS-TEST | 001-011 | `tests/unit/sys_test/` and `tests/integration/sys_test/` | external adjudication and release evidence fixtures |

## Automated Test Requirements

Each story's test module must use deterministic standard-library-only tests,
exact type checks, fail-closed validation, and no external I/O. Boundary cases
must cover empty/minimum, maximum, malformed, duplicate, stale, and blocked
inputs where the story names them. Tests must assert observable call counts and
terminal status, not implementation details that are outside the story.

### SYS-SAVE

- Story 007: blocking context reset, disabled shortcuts, main-menu/new-game
  exits, OS quit, and persistent-root preservation.
- Story 008: journal dual entry, focus restoration, blocked-phase visibility,
  and recovery preemption.
- Story 009: persistent ownership, complete-root replacement, run/save/load
  invariance, and no persistent mutation during per-run restore.
- Story 010: slot metadata semantics, keyboard focus, accessible labels,
  no-hover/no-timed path, and blocked-state presentation.
- Story 011: nearest-rank latency budget, sample validation, warm-up handling,
  and report-only behavior when no approved threshold exists.
- Story 012: production catalog freeze, candidate identity, test-only scan,
  evidence completeness, and cross-generation rejection.

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Python unit and integration suites pass for the Story currently being closed.
2. Existing SYS-SAVE regression suite remains green after every save/persist
   implementation change.
3. A clean process can import all new pure modules without engine-only imports.
4. Save/load/persistent contracts preserve data and reject blocked inputs.
5. No production module imports or discovers test-only modules/data.
6. Ren'Py lint/testcase execution is recorded as NOT RUN when the pinned engine
   binary is unavailable; this is a warning, never an unreported pass.

## Definition of Done

- Exact test-evidence file exists and passes for every Logic/Integration Story.
- UI Stories have an interaction test or evidence document.
- Code review has no unresolved blocking findings.
- Story file is updated by story-done to `Status: Complete` with completion
  notes and evidence path.
- Smoke result is recorded after the story and the full suite is rerun at the
  end of the production range.
